title: Every logarithmic Smirnov function extends to the Hilbert polydisc
established: Every radial Nevanlinna function on the $\ell^1$ polydisc extends uniquely and Fr\'echet holomorphically to the Hilbert polydisc. The latter is exactly the domain of continuous polynomial evaluation for the logarithmic metric.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: Every stated Smirnov function extends holomorphically to the Hilbert polydisc; no proposed nonextendible example exists.
